purpose: Teach: 酵母/菜園/人影/たまらなく/敷き/知ったかぶる/恥じ/押せ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、パン作りの、絶対、酵母、絶対、勉強してるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — I'm really studying yeast fermentation for bread baking.
lines.style: Warm and direct, speaking to a child with gentle earnestness. Slightly slower pace to ensure clarity. Soft openness in the voice, like sharing something real.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お庭の、絶対、菜園、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お手伝いしたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to help you in the garden with the vegetables.
lines.style: Bright and eager, the small voice of a six-year-old speaking to an older sister he trusts. Quick warm pulse on 'help'. Genuine enthusiasm without performed cuteness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、夜の道で、絶対、人影、絶対、見えると、絶対、安心するわ、翔くん、本気for
lines.en: You know, Sho, it makes me feel safe — seeing your shape in the dark when I come home late.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Speaking more to herself than to him, but with him present. Tenderness underneath — the realization of how much his presence matters. Slight trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さんに、絶対、たまらなく、絶対、会いたい時があるんだ
lines.en: Sometimes, Mei-sis, I just really, really want to see you.
lines.style: Small voice, genuine ache underneath. Not performed sadness — just the honest weight of missing someone. Slight catch on the second 'really', like he's letting himself feel it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんが、本気で、絶対、お家、絶対、敷き、絶対、ラグ、絶対、新しく替えたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I actually just replaced the rug in the living room with a new one.
lines.style: Lighter, almost playful. A small shift in tone — sharing a domestic detail like it's a gift. Warmth picks up slightly, inviting him into the space. Clear and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、知ったかぶる、絶対、ような、絶対、こと、絶対、しないようにするよ、メイ姉さん
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to stop pretending I know things when I don't.
lines.style: Earnest and soft, the determination of a six-year-old making a real promise. Not performative — he means it. Steady rhythm, slight weight on the commitment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、失敗を、絶対、恥じる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、挑戦、絶対、しましょうね
lines.en: Let's try new things together, Sho — without being afraid of failing.
lines.style: Tender and encouraging. Gentle opening. Steady voice that carries quiet conviction. The tone of someone who believes in him. Slight lift at 'together', warmth on the permission.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ベルを、絶対、押せば、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家から、絶対、出るね
lines.en: Mei-sis, when I ring the doorbell, I'll be coming home to you.
lines.style: Bright and certain. The simple joy of a young child announcing something that matters deeply. Clean attack on the opening. Warmth and hope in equal measure, like a promise he's making.
